# harmoniq_alert_rule (Resource)

An alert rule on module health (or webhook failures). `auto_rollback` aborts the module's canary, or rolls back to the previous version, when the rule triggers. Rates are fractions between 0 and 1; times are milliseconds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Abort the checkout canary in production when more than 5% of its loads fail.
resource "harmoniq_alert_rule" "checkout_canary_errors" {
  workspace      = harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team.slug
  name           = "checkout canary errors"
  condition      = "canary_error_rate"
  threshold      = 0.05
  action         = "auto_rollback"
  module_id      = harmoniq_remote_module.checkout.id
  environment    = harmoniq_environment.production.slug
  window_minutes = 10
  min_samples    = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `webhook` (send `alert.triggered` / `alert.resolved`) or `auto_rollback`.
- `condition` (String) `canary_error_rate`, `canary_error_rate_delta`, `canary_load_p95ms`, `load_success_rate`, `load_p95ms` (module conditions) or `webhook_failure_rate`.
- `name` (String) Name, unique in the workspace.
- `threshold` (Number) Trigger value.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Minutes before the rule can trigger again (0–1440, default 15).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is evaluated (default `true`).
- `environment` (String) Environment slug in the module's host app; required for module conditions.
- `min_samples` (Number) Samples needed before the rule can trigger (default 20).
- `module_id` (String) Module id (`harmoniq_remote_module.x.id`); required for module conditions.
- `window_minutes` (Number) Evaluation window in minutes (1–60, default 5).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harmoniq_alert_rule.checkout_canary_errors checkout-team/<rule-id>
```
